title: A bigger space to find your terrain

features.title: Browse by category
features.description: All scenery is organised by what it is, rather than downloadable packs. Find floors, walls, openings, trees, plants, traps and more together.

features.title: Narrow it down
features.description: Use subcategories such as Curved walls, Flowers or Cave entrances, and combine them with search.

features.title: Expand your library
features.description: Choose Expand library for larger previews in a spacious browsing window. Click a piece to return to your scene ready to place it. Your filters stay selected.
